body:
Source: GitHub issue #1044 (bug, P2-medium, area:plugins). Re-verified on main @ 270fd0dd: `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs:155` (`runAdlc`) calls `spawnSync('adlc', args, { encoding: 'utf8' })` and `:742` (`runGit`, inside `gitChangedPaths`) calls `spawnSync('git', args, { encoding: 'utf8' })`. Neither passes a timeout, so a child that never exits blocks the process forever. Reproduced: with a `git` on PATH that runs `sleep 100000`, `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/review.test.mjs` never returns — an external 60 s timeout had to kill it, and node reported 'Promise resolution is still pending but the event loop has already resolved'. Three orphaned 12-process `npm test` trees were found on the dev machine having run 3.5-4.5 days in this state.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs` is the hook body (~2100 lines); `adlc-hook-run.mjs` is the wrapper `hooks/hooks.json` actually invokes, and it self-terminates per mode (`TIMEOUTS_MS`: rails/buildgate/handoff 10 s, review 25 s, preflight 55 s), mapping a timeout to deny for enforcing modes. So production is bounded TODAY by the wrapper alone; anything calling the hook body directly — every test in `hooks/test/` — is not. This ticket removes the dependence on that single outer bound. The same file already holds both patterns to copy: `boundedHandoffRead` at `:1747` spawns with `timeout` + `killSignal: 'SIGKILL'`, the `adlc` spawn at `:2129` passes `timeout: 5000`, and `repoManifestChainIsSigned` at `:1976` bounds a whole multi-step operation against one deadline (`MANIFEST_SCAN_DEADLINE_MS`) rather than per call. `runAdlc` has 6 call sites (`:364, :500, :555, :833, :1028, :1496`); `gitChangedPaths` issues several git commands in sequence. Tests drive the real hook as a subprocess against a temp git repo — copy the `initRepo`/`runReview` helpers in `hooks/test/review.test.mjs`. Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. `GIT_SCAN_DEADLINE_MS = 5000`, a single budget for the WHOLE of `gitChangedPaths`, not per call: each `runGit` passes `timeout: Math.max(1, GIT_SCAN_DEADLINE_MS - elapsed)` and `killSignal: 'SIGKILL'`. Per-call timeouts would let N blocked commands cost N x the budget. An exhausted budget makes later calls fail immediately and the function returns the paths gathered so far, which matches its documented contract: any git failure yields an empty set rather than throwing, because `review` is advisory and must never crash.
2. `ADLC_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000` with `killSignal: 'SIGKILL'` for `runAdlc`, matching the existing `adlc` spawn at `:2129`. A timeout sets `result.error`, which `runAdlc` already maps to `null` (its documented no-op signal), so no call site changes.
3. NO environment override for either value. A caller-settable timeout would let an operator shrink `review`'s git scan to nothing and silently drop its coverage — the timeout is a safety bound, not a tuning knob.
4. No behaviour change when children respond normally: same commands, same arguments, same parsing, same outputs, same exit codes.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 With a `git` on PATH that never exits, the `review` mode terminates and stays well inside the wrapper's 25 s budget instead of hanging. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/spawn-timeout.test.mjs`
- AC2 The git budget is whole-operation, not per call: with a blocking `git`, total elapsed stays under 2 x GIT_SCAN_DEADLINE_MS even though several git commands are attempted. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/spawn-timeout.test.mjs`
- AC3 With an `adlc` on PATH that never exits, a mode that calls `runAdlc` terminates bounded rather than hanging. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/spawn-timeout.test.mjs`
- AC4 The new test file sets an explicit per-test `timeout`, so a regression FAILS the run instead of wedging it. verify: `grep -c "timeout:" plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/spawn-timeout.test.mjs` (>= 1)
- AC5 Normal behaviour is unchanged. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally)

OUT OF SCOPE: bounding each segment inside `scripts/run-tests.mjs` (issue #1044 recommendation 3 — separate change, different file, different blast radius); the same pattern in other plugins' hooks; diagnosing why a child blocks under codex-linux-sandbox; any change to `adlc-hook-run.mjs`'s own timeouts.
title: adlc-claude-code: bound the hook's git and adlc spawns so a blocked child cannot hang the process
